Rocket Science
	

Time-aligned video, keyboard actions, game events, and per-frame game state for all four players, captured from a 2v2 Rocket League match.
This is the dataset behind MIRA, a real-time multiplayer world model trained to simulate Rocket League gameplay — by General Intuition and Kyutai, in collaboration with Epic Games. Code, technical report,
and a live demo: github.com/mira-wm/mira ·
mira-wm.com.
